presets.name: Octave squeal
presets.desc: A held note blooms into its octave after 0.4 s, phase-locked to the string and following its bends
presets.notes: Before a high-gain amp: the amp gives the octave its grit. Bloom 0 dB lets the octave reach the note's own body level

presets.name: Singing fundamental
presets.desc: The note itself stops dying: its fundamental is topped up from 0.2 s on, so the note just keeps singing
presets.notes: The generated partial only supplies what the string has lost (g = a − d): no doubling, no step when it starts

presets.name: Twelfth scream
presets.desc: The octave and a fifth above the note screams in fast and loud once the note is held
presets.notes: The 3rd harmonic: what a loud amp tends to scream at on the wound strings

presets.name: Two-octave whistle
presets.desc: A slow whistle two octaves above the held note, under the note's own level
presets.notes: The 4th harmonic fits any chord; a slow rise keeps it a whistle rather than a squeal

presets.name: Major-third whistle
presets.desc: A whistle on the 5th harmonic (two octaves and a major third) over major chords
presets.notes: The 5th harmonic is a major third: it clashes over minor chords. Use Two Octaves there

presets.name: Close to the amp
presets.desc: Natural feedback a step from the amp: the loop picks the low harmonics, jumping on bends
presets.notes: The virtual loop's phase sets which of harmonics 1 – 4 wins; a short rise is a loud, close amp

presets.name: Across the room
presets.desc: Natural feedback from across the room: slower, and the winning harmonic changes from note to note
presets.notes: At 3 m the loop's phase turns fast with pitch: neighbouring notes feed back on different harmonics

presets.name: Walk to the amp
presets.desc: Natural feedback up to the 6th harmonic whose winner moves with distance: put Distance on the expression pedal
presets.notes: EXP on distance 0.5 – 3 m: the harmonic changes every few tens of centimetres, each change a cross-fade

presets.name: String climb
presets.desc: The note sings on its fundamental, then rises to the octave, as a magnetic sustainer's harmonic mode does
presets.notes: Duck 60 % lets the dry give way as the octave takes over, so the note turns into its harmonic

presets.name: Bowed lead
presets.desc: Dry off: each note swells from silence on its fundamental, carried across hammer-ons and slides
presets.notes: With the dry at −60 dB only the phase-locked partial is heard; Legato Carry keeps the bow across notes

presets.name: Infinite note
presets.desc: Every partial of the note is held at 6 dB under its body, on its own frequency, for up to a minute
presets.notes: A partial bank, not a loop: no pumping, no hiss raised, the partials drift as on the string. Follow with a reverb

presets.name: Chord drone
presets.desc: Each note of a strummed chord is held on its own partial bank, a little darker than played
presets.notes: Chord All gives each named note (up to four) its own voice; a partial shared by two notes is held once

presets.name: Sustainer mix
presets.desc: The note held at its level with its octave blooming on it, the dry giving way a little
presets.notes: Both: the bank holds the note while the Feedback octave grows; a partial in both takes the larger level

presets.name: Held bass root
presets.desc: A bass note held on its own partials, down to 35 Hz, so a root rings under the band
presets.notes: Lowest 35 Hz switches in the long detector window (55 ms to the first reading on E1)

presets.name: Sub swell
presets.desc: An octave below the note swells in slowly under a lowered dry
presets.notes: The sub runs on its own accumulator at half the tracked fundamental's rate: no partial of the string to grow from

presets.name: Scream on the switch
presets.desc: Nothing until the footswitch: then the held note screams at the twelfth within 0.3 s
presets.notes: golem's footswitch drives Feed; releasing it fades the scream with its pitch held, no chirp

presets.name: Feedback at low volume
presets.desc: Amp-like natural feedback at bedroom or in-ear level, ahead of an amp model
presets.notes: Natural Low stops at the 4th harmonic, as the classic feedback pedals do
